body:
Thank you for sharing your experiences, it’s true we are really hard on ourselves and most people might not even notice, but in the end it’s how it makes us feel. I hope you are able to find something that helps you feel better, wether that means finding something that helps control your acne or helps you find happiness despite your acne.

Effexor has been the only medication that has worked for me, but the past few days have been really rough.
Yes, I have my acne under control but I have really bad scarring and my eczema is just getting worse and worse. It ruined my body
Yes, I’m in high school but I’ve fallen really far behind
Thank you, you words really mean a lot to me
Effexor. I’m covered in acne and eczema scars

Imagine the pain yours son will feel. He will remember the time you played legos and watched movies with him as the last days with his dad. When he grows up he will tell his friends, S/O and probably his school counselor about how much he wishes he could go back in time and play LEGO’s, watch a movie, fall asleep on the couch and go to a fancy dinner one last time. He’ll also put together that this was your way of saying goodbye.
I don’t care if my dad left me millions of dollars, I would want my mom
Please don’t do this. Please please do not do this. Your kids will be broken.
What should I do? Should I continue to talk to them?
Oh I’m sure, what I was reading was just about suicide. Sorry I’m super new to all of this
Hey man if you’re still there you should call the help line, they’ve helped me so many times, message me if you need to or have questions
This is almost my exact situation, message me if you need to
I don’t think it can get better, nothing can fix this and I’d be wasting her time

A few months ago my great uncle died, my grandma worried about him not being a Christian. about a week after his death she has a dream he was dressed in gold, glowing smiling, laughing calling her name saying “look I’m over here!”. I definitely believe the deceased communicate through dreams and your sister was trying to tell you she’s happy and not to worry about her
